p2-o14.actual: POST /api/my/bookings now reads the listing's ageCaps/ageCapsOn and, when on, matches each child to the tenant's ratio group (settings.ratioGroups) covering their age and enforces that group's per-day cap inside the same booking transaction as the block-wide capacity check — refusing (or waitlisting, per the listing's normal waitlist setting) exactly like a full block already does, and updating an in-memory running tally so two lines in the SAME basket can't both slip past the same day's cap. Verified against the live dev API: seeded a tenant with a ratio group 'Under 5s' (age 0-4) capped at 1 place/day on a listing with waitlist off, and a block with plenty of block-wide capacity (20). 1st under-5 booking (age 3) -> Confirmed. 2nd under-5 booking -> refused 409 ('Under 5s is full...') even though the block itself was nowhere near full, proving the band cap (not just block capacity) is what stopped it. A 3rd booking for a child OUTSIDE the capped band (age 8, no cap set for that band) still booked normally on the same day, proving the cap is per-band, not block-wide.
p2-o14.notes: Enforcement is deliberately at the same GROUP granularity the existing block-wide fits check already uses (a date-group of same-day basket lines is placed or waitlisted as one atomic unit) — so if a mixed-age date-group would breach ANY represented band's cap on ANY day, the whole group is treated as not fitting, same all-or-nothing semantics the surrounding code already documents for block capacity ('the whole basket gets places or the whole basket waitlists'). A child whose age doesn't fall in any configured ratio group, or whose band has no cap set (only some bands need to be capped), is unaffected — matches the wizard's own 'blank = no limit' semantics for ageCaps.
